full_name: Barbara C. Scholz | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2005–2006 Humanities Frieda L. Miller Fellow University of California, Santa Cruz
bio: Barbara C. Scholz is a philosopher of the cognitive sciences with a special interest in the philosophical issues relating to linguistics, such as the implications of different formal frameworks for syntactic theory, and psycholinguistics, particularly developmental psycholinguistics.
